snippet.title: VRChat - Create, Share, Play
snippet.description:
VRChat offers an endless collection of social VR experiences by giving the power of creation to its community. Whether you're looking for new VR experiences or have an idea of your own, VRChat is the place to be.

Visit our Website: http://vrchat.com
Follow us on Twitter: http://twitter.com/VRChatnet
Stay connected on our Discord: http://discord.gg/vrchat
Share your feedback on Canny: http://vrchat.canny.io
